questions.stem: A distance-time graph shows a horizontal line. What does this represent?
questions.explanation: A horizontal line on a distance-time graph means distance is not changing, so the object is stationary.

questions.stem: On a velocity-time graph, the area under the line represents:
questions.explanation: The area under a velocity-time graph gives the distance travelled.

questions.stem: A water tank fills at a constant rate for 10 minutes, then empties at twice the rate. If it starts empty and reaches 200 litres, how long until it is empty again?
questions.explanation: Fill rate = 200/10 = 20 litres/min. Empty rate = 2 x 20 = 40 litres/min. Time to empty = 200/40 = 5 minutes.

questions.stem: On a distance-time graph, the gradient represents:
questions.explanation: Gradient = change in distance / change in time = speed.

questions.stem: A conversion graph shows that 5 miles = 8 km. How many kilometres is 30 miles?
questions.explanation: 5 miles = 8 km. 30 miles = 30 x (8/5) = 30 x 1.6 = 48 km.
